craft_notes: Sthāyin: who-may-be-reclaimed (FIRST-VERSE of the batch: plain injunctive catalogue; sets the workmanlike voice — owner verdict required before treating as house voice). Sanskrit: vaiṣṇavādi...unmukhīkriyante → L4 keeps who-list then rule. Rows: row 3 (turned→rule). Close: worshipped (pūjā as landing). Rejected: smoothing the catalogue — kept whole (the list IS the verse); 'convert' — kept turned-hither (unmukhī as facing-toward).

lines: Who stands where Vaiṣṇavas end and southern tantras begin, or holds their vows —
even highest men serving unentitled lower gurus: when the Lord's falling turns them hither,
then this their rule: fast-kept, next-day, common-worshipped, told, led before the Lord;
vow taken, cast in water; bathed, sprinkled, gruel-and-toothstick-pure, blindfold led —
by common mantra let the Lord be worshipped.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādidakṣiṇatantrānteṣu śāsaneṣu ye sthitāḥ tadgṛhītavratā vā ye ca uttamaśāsanasthā api anadhikṛtādharaśāsanagurūpasevinaḥ te yadā śaktipātena pārameśvareṇa unmukhīkriyante tadā teṣām ayaṃ vidhiḥ tatra enaṃ kṛtopavāsam anyadine sādhāraṇamantrapūjitasya tadīyāṃ ceṣṭāṃ śrāvitasya bhagavato 'gre praveśayet tatrāsya vrataṃ gṛhītvā ambhasi kṣipet tato 'sau snāyāt tataḥ prokṣya carudantakāṣṭhābhyāṃ saṃskṛtya baddhanetraṃ praveśya sādhāraṇena mantreṇa parameśvarapūjāṃ kārayet

reads_against.argmap: Who may be reclaimed, and how unwound? → Converts from any lower order are receivable on one condition: the Lord's turning-them-hither; then unwound in order — fasted, worshipped, confessed, led in, vow cast in water, bathed, purified, blindfolded, worshipped anew.
c1_essence: Converts from any lower order receivable on the Lord's turning-them-hither; unwound in order: fasted, worshipped, confessed, led in, vow cast in water, bathed, purified, blindfolded, worshipped anew.
